The final application changed the active source/fhir.ini workgroup display label for the stable vocab workgroup id from Vocabulary to Terminology Infrastructure.
additional_context: TSC Confluence minutes record approval of the Vocabulary WG name change request on 2023-02-13. Current source/fhir.ini remains the build-scope authority for workgroup display metadata and now maps the stable vocab id to Terminology Infrastructure. The remaining vocab id and legacy committee URL are stable metadata identifiers rather than user-facing old WG-name text.
